agent_config.run_facts:
Dataset: XAUUSD spot gold quotes, 1290 sessions on the pre-registered train split.

Fill model: quotes-unfavorable -- a fill requires a price move strictly through your limit, so you pay the spread on every entry and exit.

Commission: 0.03 per unit per side. Gold quotes in USD per troy ounce, mid near $2,000. The quotes fill model does not walk the bid/ask spread, so this commission already includes the half-spread: a round trip costs roughly 0.06 points per unit (~3 bps).

Action cap: 64 per session. History window: 512 bars.

record.note: MVP campaign, governed by docs/design/pre-registration.md. Real xauusd train split. The model proposes one strategy at a time and edits the champion; the null is the sign-flip over round turns (section 3b), NOT the conditional null, so the measured FWER of 0.060 does not describe this campaign.
record.stopping_rule: fixed budget; no early stop on any observed result
